admin.title.videoOnlyHelp.en: Each episode's video with its ad clips. Nothing here needs translating; to translate an episode, add its subtitle or script file below.

wb.workflow.videoOnly.body.zh: 这一集的广告切片会自动切好（见剧集页的“广告切片”）。如果要翻译它，在剧集页添加它的字幕或剧本文件。
